nodes.text: Mumbai has reported another case of #HMPV today, bringing India’s total to 11. As the case continues to rise, the central government urges states to intensify surveillance. People aged 5 to 70 are susceptible to this virus, which exhibits symptoms similar to Covid-19. Stay safe!
